borrower_name: Charter Oak Companion & Home Care LLC
industry: Non-Medical Home Care & Elder Support Services

facility_request.facility_type: Revolving Working Capital Line of Credit
facility_request.collateral: First-lien UCC-1 on accounts receivable ($145,000 eligible A/R) + blanket business assets + personal guarantees.
facility_request.purpose: Bridge bi-weekly caregiver payroll ahead of 30-to-45 day state waiver and private-pay reimbursements.

qualitative_notes.business_overview: Licensed non-medical homecare agency providing 24/7 companion, homemaker, and personal care services across Hartford County.
strengths: 24.9% compound annual revenue growth driven by expanding Connecticut Home Care Program for Elders (CHCPE) referrals and private-pay clients.
Gross margin expanded from 37.0% to 39.0% through automated EVV scheduling and overtime reduction.
risks: Accounts receivable days increased from 42.6 days to 43.5 days due to state Medicaid waiver reimbursement batching cycles.
Direct care workforce turnover requires continuous recruiting and onboarding spend.
qualitative_notes.management_experience: Managing principals bring 14 years combined healthcare administration and financial operations experience.
